messages:
anna: Heads-up — we're getting a steady stream of tool-invoke rejects from the new invoke-shim canary. Console just shows `validation_failed` and the request falls back to text-gen. No clear reason why.

mike: Ugh. Which validator is rejecting? heatmap on telemetry?

anna: Example log from the shim:
```
{"req_id":"r-9a2f","model":"gptx-2","tool":"search.v1","result":"rejected","reason":"schema_mismatch","validator":"strict-json-2","received":"{\"items\":[]}","expected":"{\"items\": [{\"id\":\"string\",\"score\":\"number\"}]}"}
```

lucy: So the shim is rejecting when `items` is empty. We've seen similar in validation tests but production load is different.

sam: Where is this surfaced in the Console? I just see a failed invoke counter and a toggled fallback metric.

anna: Exactly — Console shows counts but not the canonical rejection reason or example payload. SRE asked for a quick root-cause to decide on canary rollback.

mike: We intentionally kept the error details minimal for privacy, but we should show aggregated reasons: top 5 rejection reasons + a sampled payload (redacted) per reason. That should be safe.

lucy: Agreed. Also need routing policy visibility: which requests were routed to shim vs classic adapter. Right now we can't correlate rejects to routing decisions.

sam: Telemetry currently emits `invoke.reject` with tags {validator:, model:, tool:} but payload sampling is off. We can flip a sampling flag in the agent to start sending 1% of redacted payloads to events pipeline.

anna: Can we also add a Console panel: "Invoke rejects by reason" and link to the sampled payload viewer? UX should let ops drill from reason => sample => request headers.

mike: I can add the panel. For rollout UX, we should wire a canary slice selector to show reject rates for the canary group specifically. If reject rate > threshold -> auto-alert.

lucy: One more: quota interplay. When a strict validator rejects, we currently still bill the customer for tokens. Ops wants to know if fallback-to-text caused unexpected billing spikes.

sam: Good call. We'll tag events with billing impact flags: `billed_tokens` and `fallback_used`. That will let Finance query anomalous cost.

anna: Proposal: short-term -> enable payload sampling (1%), add "rejection reasons" panel, canary slice breakdown, expose sample viewer. Medium-term -> allow toggleable validator strictness per route and a dry-run mode that logs but doesn't reject.

mike: Sounds reasonable. For medium-term, need API change (route config: `validatorMode: strict|warn|dry_run`). Devex/SDK will need docs.

lucy: I'll draft the console mock for the sample viewer and new panel. Anna, please collect 5 example reject payloads and any customer ids we should hide.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued: telemetry/enable-payload-sampling -> staging

sam: I'll own the telemetry flip and ensure redaction rules run before event ingestion.

anna: Thanks. If we see >2% rejects for canary in 30m after sampling is enabled, we'll pause the rollout and reconvene here.

mike: I'll create the rollout playbook change and alert rule. Thanks all :thumbsup:
